description: Reading the blockr options that core asks R for as soon as R has answered its hello: the three that its scheduler reads, and rand_id, the shape of the ids that its commands mint. The app sets evaluation_queue as the R option blockr.evaluation_queue, which arrives as the number it holds, and the deployment sets BLOCKR_BACKGROUND_EVALUATION_DELAY, which arrives as the string an environment variable holds, for the client to convert to its fallback's type. Nothing sets gate_visibility, which R leaves out, so that the client takes its fallback. The app sets blockr.rand_id to uuid and the deployment sets BLOCKR_RAND_ID to letters_8. R cannot read a blockr option whose R option and environment variable disagree, so it leaves rand_id out, with a warning in its log, and the client takes its fallback for rand_id alone.
